item.title: Traffic diversions at Lakeview Junction for 30 days from Monday
item.dc:creator: Staff Reporter
item.description: Motorists heading towards Station Road will be diverted at Lakeview Junction while a storm drain is rebuilt, police said.
item.content:encoded:
Motorists heading towards Station Road will be diverted at Lakeview Junction while a storm drain is rebuilt, police said.

The work is expected to take 30 days.
